facts.fact: According to the National Retail Federation, the holiday total for online and other non-store sales was up 8.2% at $276.8 billion USD in 2023.
facts.quote: The holiday total for online and other non-store sales, was up 8.2% at $276.8 billion USD.

facts.fact: According to US Census Bureau data cited by the National Retail Federation, core retail sales during the 2023 holiday season grew 3.8% over 2022 to a record $964.4 billion USD.
facts.quote: US Census Bureau data shows that core retail sales during the 2023 holiday season grew 3.8% over 2022 to a record $964.4 billion USD.

facts.fact: Full-year 2023 retail sales grew 3.6% over 2022 to a record $5.13 trillion USD, per the National Retail Federation.
facts.quote: In 2023, sales for the full year grew 3.6% over 2022 to a record $5.13 trillion USD.

facts.fact: In 2023, all but two of nine retail categories increased, with electronics and personal care leading with growth of 9% or more, per the National Retail Federation.
facts.quote: In 2023, all but two of nine retail categories increased, with electronics and personal care categories leading the way, growing by 9% or more this past year.

facts.fact: StackAdapt advises looking at data from the previous two years of Black Friday and Cyber Monday ad campaigns for the most relevant insights.
facts.quote: For the most relevant insights, look at data from the previous two years.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that holiday campaigns typically start weeks before key dates.
facts.quote: Holiday campaigns typically start weeks before key dates.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that most users need to encounter ads several times before they are likely to convert in today's programmatic advertising landscape.
facts.quote: most users need to encounter your ads several times before they are likely to convert.

facts.fact: Black Friday and Cyber Monday are described by StackAdapt as the two biggest shopping days of the year that kick off the holiday season.
facts.quote: Black Friday and Cyber Monday are the two biggest shopping days of the year that kick off the holiday season.

facts.fact: Black Friday is the day after Thanksgiving (US), and Cyber Monday falls on the following Monday.
facts.quote: Black Friday is the day after Thanksgiving (US), and Cyber Monday falls on the following Monday.

facts.fact: BFCM is an acronym that stands for Black Friday, Cyber Monday, and marketers use it to refer to the online and in-store sales event that kicks off the holiday shopping season.
facts.quote: BFCM is an acronym that stands for Black Friday, Cyber Monday.

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes dynamic retargeting as serving a user an ad for a product or service they previously saw, now with a price tag, to encourage further engagement and brand recall.
facts.quote: You can serve an ad that a user has previously seen, but this time with a price tag.
